falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 80% pattern match to bottom_2024_aug is invalidated because the August 2024 bottom held above 5,100; a drop to 4,800 would represent a structural breakdown, not a similar bottoming formation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 3 consecutive trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The BLOWOFF SCORE of 40 suggests controlled de-risking, not panic; sustained VIX above 35 indicates capitulation-level fear that contradicts the 'bottom' pattern and would signal a genuine crisis rather than a tradable low

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.50% while S&P 500 simultaneously drops more than 5% from current levels
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This combination invalidates the verdict because it signals a deflationary/recessionary shock rather than the growth-scare-then-recovery dynamic that characterized August 2024; the pattern match fails if bonds rally on flight-to-safety rather than rate-cut repricing
